t: You're looking at 20 Buckingham Gate, a building in the City of Westminster. It was designed by Reginald Blomfield, a prolific British architect, garden designer and author of the Victorian and Edwardian period. Blomfield's name is the main thing the record gives us here, so I'll say no more than that. If you like architecture, it's worth pausing to look at the façade with his name in mind, and to see how it sits among the neighbouring buildings along the street.
